prompt: Edit this existing Minecraft mod GUI preview only by making the overall UI surface colors subtly darker for comparison. Reduce perceived luminance of the broad blue panel fills, inset panels, tabs and button backgrounds by approximately 10 percent; title and active blue accents may be about 6 percent darker. Preserve the current rich blue hue and saturation, gradients, fine diagonal texture, angular motifs, metallic finish and exact layout. Keep ALL text, characters, icon details, slot contents, tank amber fuel, cyan progress bar and important thin outlines at their existing readable brightness. Preserve the exact canvas dimensions, panel geometry, every word and number, and all functional details. Do not redraw, rearrange, add, remove or translate anything. The difference should be modest and immediately comparable, not a dramatic dark theme. Keep outside background essentially unchanged. Produce the complete edited GUI preview with no labels or comparison captions.
